title: Chephs Special - The only wife Paner with Brown Onion Potato Ku
description: Chef's Special - Kadai Matar Paneer  with Brown Onion Potato Kulcha INGREDIENTS: Cloves   -   5 nos. Cardamom   -   4 nos. Cinnamon   -   3 nos Coriander seeds  -   1 tsp Fennel seeds  -   1 tsp Cumin seeds  -   ½ tsp Black pepper  -   1 tsp Red chillies  -   4 nos. Onions   -   1 no. Salt   -   As per taste Ginger garlic paste -   1 tsp Turmeric powder -   ½ tsp Tomato puree  -   1 cup   Red chilli powder -   1 tsp Cashew nut powder  -   6 tsp Water   -   As required  Green Peas   -  1 cup Paneer (pieces) -   500 gms Kasuri Methi Powder -   2 tsp Capsicum   -   2 nos. Coriander leaves -   1 bunch Yeast   -   1 tsp Warm water   -   As required  Sugar   -   1 tsp Cream   -   1 cup All-purpose flour  -   1 cup Butter    -   4 cubes DIRECTIONS: Heat cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, coriander seeds, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, black pepper dry roast it and transfer into a plate. Later, ground it finely.  Heat oil in a pan, add red chillies, onions, salt, ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder,  tomato puree, red chilli powder saute it. After adding cashew nut powder and saute it nicely again. Then add water, green peas cook it for few minutes and add paneer pieces, kasuri methi powder, capsicum when the moisture oozes out of the gravy.    At last, add cream, coriander leaves cook it for a  minute.   Take a bowl add yeast, add warm water, sugar mix it once and add all-purpose flour mix it well and make a soft dough rest it for 15-20 minutes.   Take  brown onions  crushed it and add cumin powder, salt, mashed potato mixed it and make dumplings Stuff the dough, roll it,  cook into the potato kulchas, apply butter both sides golden in color.  Delicious Kadai Matar Paneer brown onion ready to serve with potato kulcha. asr.full_text: You know how I can define this taste.. There is a great romance between this kurpi and the karai and the result is just love the love of good food. The finger-licking good of brown onion potato kulcha is, of course stop with a little bit butter and having it with paneer karai matar I'm telling you this is just outstanding. Imagine the double-dose of butter in the kadai paneer, kesuri methi and this butter and this kulcha with little bit butter this is going to be just too good you know how i can define this taste hmm Namaste, Salaamwalekum, Satriyakaal, welcome back to another session with your VahChef at Vahrehvah.com and today we're going to learn how to make kadai matar paneer. we are going to use the real kadai here. first, we're going to make the kadai masala and you know we're going to use seven spice pot, not five spice like Chinese just for fun i'm saying you are going to use all spice you know we got use cloves and cardamom cinnamon and the coriander seeds and fennel seeds and some cumin seeds in a kadai spice you know in each area it is different you can use your own spices you're going to take some black pepper and add to this so here the black cardamom I'm going to use it you know in the gravy the slow dry roasting of the ingredients will bring out the nice flavor of these ingredients so once they are pounded we are going to add it you know almost when the gravy is cooked and then this gives a very nice flavor do not burn any of the ingredients on a slow flame cook them till the nice aroma is out so here all the coriander seeds everything is getting cooked and transfer this onto a plate and we are going to let this cool down, once all these things are cooled down we are going to put in a pestle Dink chicken, chicken, chicken and then we are going to do dink chicken of these ingredients and we are going to add it in the last. In the khadai we're going to add some oil and we're going to get my favorite kurpi you know I'm known for this in the college I'm not going to tell what it is not a worthy story to tell Here we're going to add black cardamom so the red chilli break it into pieces and add to this let these red chillies slightly sizzle in the oil the nice flavor from the red chillies come out kadai means full of flavors you know that's how we're going to cook this These red chillies also start turning out the color in this we're going to add finely chopped onion the moment I add onions I also add some salt we're going to saute these onions till they are slightly golden because you want a very nice gravy and this gravy is going to be red and full flavorful when you cook in a kadai, the entire ingredients because you see the larger area all the masalas get roasted even any pothos you add they get nicely roasted and the ingredients also get you know slightly cooked you keep scraping scraping scraping and that gives very good taste Think about that bunad chicken and all those things, in this we're going to add ginger garlic paste look at this the onions you know getting nicely golden and that too evenly getting colored that is what we can achieve in a kadai. In this we're going to add turmeric tomatoes put in a blender make a puree and then we are going to add tomato puree this tomato puree needs to be cooked see when you're cooking in a normal vessel it takes a lot more time and in a kadai because the surface area is lot more it gets cooked much faster in this we are going to add chilli powder I suggest you use Kashmiri chilli powder because that gives a very nice red colour so here nice Kashmiri chilli powder and mix it well then you can start seeing some oil coming from this that means the gravy is ready now in this we want to get a very nice gravy and I've shown you another recipe where I've used roasted chickpea flour and here i'm going to use cashew nut powder but instead of adding cashew nut powder in the gravy i'm going to add it in this see move the masala on the side and on the other side just sprinkle the cashew nut powder, saute it little bit, cashew nut thing will get stuck at the bottom, the rawness, we're going to cook like this till it stops sticking at the bottom, you do not want anything to burn. Now the masala is all done we have to add water, The cashew nut everything will be excellent and don't worry this will all thicken and become a very nice gravy, the gravy is nice silky add the green peas it is going to take some few minutes to come to a boil and the nice green chilli or capsicum would be excellent in this so i'm going to add some green chilli this is nicely getting cook we're going add this masala's usually I add it little later but with the paneer masala the 7 spices whatever i added make it little bit coarse powder and this gravy the entire flavor everything will change and also there is one more thing kasoori methi which I'll add so first in this we are going to add paneer in the road side dahbas you must have seen that they're going to add paneer. In the roadside dhabas you must have seen that they fry the paneer and add, if the paneer is getting little bit you know slimy and all that they fry it but if it is fresh paneer always add fresh paneer into this and it will be good. In this the magical spices you know kasuri methi, not so much little bit of kasuri methi and just put it in between your you know palms and make kasuri methi not so much little bit of kasuri methi and just put it in between you know palms and make a fine powder of it so look at this kasuri methi is useless if you don't add butter you know for me you don't have to add but for me I love to add butter. In this I'm going to add butter ok and add capsicum and look at the nice gravy you know if you want slightly thinner you can do it but i love to make it like this the gravy is ready the salt you know i added perfect you know last when you add the cream i have already shown you the technique that your cream should not curdle take a spoon take some of the gravy and temper the cream, tempering means basically you add some of the gravy to the cream and mix it so that it doesn't curdle now we're going to add this cream this is very diluted cream in this add it and mix this and just bring it to one boil is all perfect if you want to finish it off by some chopped coriander that's also fine the kadai paneer is already to be served and with this we're going to have you know brown onion potato kulcha have you ever had it, so this is very tasty, with this we're going to have that to make this kulcha we're going to use all purpose flour that is maida and we going to add a little bit of yeast see in the kulcha you don't add as much as yeast you add for bread but little bit even in the naan we do so first we're going to take yeast and add some warm water. Look at those pearls they will get dissolved once you add a little bit of warm water once these things get dissolved in this the food for the yeast is sugar so the moment you add sugar the yeast starts getting active because this is dry yeast we need to make that active and little bit of this warm water and the yeast look at this yeast is slowly dissolving into this and what we do is here you can make rich doughs some people love to add an egg some people add yogurt, milk whatever you want you know you can enrich this mixture and make the dough. You add all-purpose flour into this mixture, make this into a soft dough, I already have a dough because my curry is ready and you know the dough is also ready, so I'm going to show you how to make the Kulcha with the ready-made dough, look at the dough this is nice soft. I'm going to divide this into a smaller portion because i don't want to have a big kulcha, i want to make smaller kulchas and enjoy. We're going to add brown onion and potatoes kulcha, Take the brown onions like this, this much should be good enough because brown onions are very flavorful I am pretty much known as a biryani boy so I always have the brown onions ready in my kitchen, you're going to crush the brown onion. In this we're going add little bit of Jeera powder, this is the only flavoring that we're going to add with the brown onions, little bit of salt. In this we're going to add potato, the potato and brown onion kulcha look at the amount of brown onions we are adding in this just mix this one the crunchy onion will become little bit soft along with this potato mixture and this is the stuffing that i am going to use it in my kulcha you know this mixture has to be soft otherwise your kulcha will tear and come out so once you add the onions everything you have to it is very nice sweet onion flavor and the potatoes this one i'm going to divide them into four portions for my kulchas and the size of the stuffing should be same as that as the dough mixture, to make this kulcha you know sprinkle some flour because this is very very sticky flatten the dough see this is nice and sticky so that's how it should be, put the onions potato stuffing in the center seal the edges and do not be in a hurry roll them off, once you do the stuffing then slowly the potato spread it with your hand you don't need to roll them if you want you can just put it on the table make it with the hand that should be good enough I do not want a big-sized kulchas I want them to be nice small and round and these will come out super tasty cook it on the both sides later we're going to add butter on top just move it on the side and dust off any extra flour we're going to add another one you know once you put it on the stove they will slightly puff up a little bit these kulchas come out good, we are going to add butter, cook well on both sides and then this is puffing up good once you have this fantastic kulchas then we're going to serve it with the curry. Kulchas are all ready and we have this hot kadai paneer and when you put it on a nice white plate you will see this beautiful color of this gravy that is why this is called kadai paneer because of a very nice flavor of the capsicum and everything in this gravy always you know I love to add little bit of butter on top while this butter melts kadai paneer will become even more tasty look at the kulchas, the kulchas have to be nice and light inside the stuffing is extraordinary i'm going to tear one kulcha and I'm going to open it, it's so hot the nice brown onion and the stuffing anybody can cook just follow the recipe very simple just follow step-by- step and your curry will be excellent and your family will be crazy about your food mmm make these curries at home and you will obviously you will say vahrehvah ah...every bite is out of the world you know how I can define this taste ah mmm How would I define this taste ?

Chef's Special - Kadai Matar Paneer with Brown Onion Potato Kulcha INGREDIENTS: Cloves - 5 nos. Cardamom - 4 nos. Cinnamon - 3 nos Coriander seeds - 1 tsp Fennel seeds - 1 tsp Cumin seeds - ½ tsp Black pepper - 1 tsp Red chillies - 4 nos. Onions - 1 no. Salt - As per taste Ginger garlic paste - 1 tsp Turmeric powder - ½ tsp Tomato puree - 1 cup Red chilli powder - 1 tsp Cashew nut powder - 6 tsp Water - As required Green Peas - 1 cup Paneer (pieces) - 500 gms Kasuri Methi Powder - 2 tsp Capsicum - 2 nos. Coriander leaves - 1 bunch Yeast - 1 tsp Warm water - As required Sugar - 1 tsp Cream - 1 cup All-purpose flour - 1 cup Butter - 4 cubes DIRECTIONS: Heat cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, coriander seeds, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, black pepper dry roast it and transfer into a plate. Later, ground it finely. Heat oil in a pan, add red chillies, onions, salt, ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder, tomato puree, red chilli powder saute it. After adding cashew nut powder and saute it nicely again. Then add water, green peas cook it for few minutes and add paneer pieces, kasuri methi powder, capsicum when the moisture oozes out of the gravy. At last, add cream, coriander leaves cook it for a minute. Take a bowl add yeast, add warm water, sugar mix it once and add all-purpose flour mix it well and make a soft dough rest it for 15-20 minutes. Take brown onions crushed it and add cumin powder, salt, mashed potato mixed it and make dumplings Stuff the dough, roll it, cook into the potato kulchas, apply butter both sides golden in color. Delicious Kadai Matar Paneer brown onion ready to

serve with potato kulcha.
